role: literal scientific input semantics; no operator evaluation
input_schema: exact dormant validator grammar from fixed driver; no extra keys accepted
explicit_input_fields: primitive factor index and X/P axis

source_fixed_semantics.mode_indexing: contract labels 1..4 map to source indices 0..3, preserving order
source_fixed_semantics.factors: L_j=dGamma(ell_j), using the two literal input arrays
source_fixed_semantics.target_K: L1^2+L2^2, unit weights; not expanded or normal ordered
source_fixed_semantics.segment: U_j=exp(-i eta x_j G_j), chronological list, U=U12...U1
source_fixed_semantics.target_formal_log: -i eta^2 K tensor I_b modulo eta^5
source_fixed_semantics.normal_form: CAR creators ascending / annihilators descending; symmetric Weyl bus
source_fixed_semantics.matching: all target scalar/one-body/two-body components retained; unwanted scalar, one-body, high-body and nonidentity bus residuals vanish
source_fixed_semantics.source_binding: science_spec.py, pipeline.py, operators.py, conditions.py at fixed driver commit; exact source identities in source_identity.json
